results.name: customer_countries
results.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS bruin_check_value FROM (SELECT customers.country AS customers_country, sum(base.amount) AS revenue FROM (SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS order_id, 101 AS customer_id, DATE '2025-01-15' AS order_date, 'US' AS country, 'completed' AS status, 'electronics' AS category, 100 AS amount
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 102, DATE '2025-01-20', 'US', 'completed', 'accessories', 50
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 101, DATE '2025-02-05', 'US', 'pending', 'electronics', 70
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 201, DATE '2025-02-10', 'DE', 'completed', 'electronics', 200
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 101, DATE '2025-03-01', 'US', 'completed', 'furniture', 300
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 201, DATE '2025-03-15', 'DE', 'cancelled', 'furniture', 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 7, 102, DATE '2025-03-20', 'US', 'completed', 'electronics', 80
) AS orders
) base LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 101 AS customer_id, 'US' AS country, 'enterprise' AS segment
  UNION ALL SELECT 102, 'US', 'startup'
  UNION ALL SELECT 201, 'DE', 'enterprise'
) AS customers
) customers ON base.customer_id = customers.customer_id GROUP BY 1) bruin_check
